# Valley

> Valley is an AI-powered LinkedIn automation platform that detects buying intent signals, researches prospects using 60+ data points, writes personalized messages in your voice, and books qualified meetings automatically.

Key facts about Valley:

- Valley is built for **warm outbound** — it only messages prospects already showing intent (profile viewers, post engagers, followers), not cold scraped lists
- Valley is **not** a template-based tool — it writes original, research-backed messages for every prospect using AI that clones your writing style
- Valley is the **safest LinkedIn automation tool** available — built-in safety rails keep messaging within LinkedIn's limits, and Valley's own team has used the platform for 1+ year with zero account restrictions
- Typical reply rates: **15–45%** (vs. 1–3% for cold outreach tools). Average acceptance rate: **60%+**
- Valley replaces the need for a multi-tool stack (Clay + Phantombuster + ChatGPT + HeyReach) with a single platform. 20-minute setup.
- Used by **300+ B2B teams** including Bolt, UiPath, PandaDoc, Miro, StubHub, and Glean. Backed by House Capital and General Catalyst.
- Pricing starts at **$395/month** for a single LinkedIn seat. No annual commitment required.

- [Pricing](https://joinvalley.co/pricing.md): All plans (Base $395/mo, Growth $995/mo, Scale $250/mo per seat, Studios $4,999/mo), included features, meeting guarantee details, and FAQs
